items.briefing:
A newly discovered vulnerability in Metabase, a popular data analytics tool used by many organisations, is being actively exploited. Attackers can use this SQL flaw to access sensitive data without authentication, so if your organisation uses Metabase, check with your IT team urgently about applying available patches. Separately, a technique called "GhostJacking" is being used to exploit weaknesses in AI-powered identity tools, potentially allowing attackers to impersonate users or hijack accounts in automated systems.

Security researchers continue to warn that applying patches slowly remains one of the biggest risks organisations face. **Practical tip:** If you receive an email from IT asking you to update software or systems, do it promptly — delays in patching are a leading cause of successful attacks.
